name: menu
title: Menu
summary: Opens a list of actions with the platform's own menu, from an icon or a ghost button.
use: For secondary actions that do not earn a place on screen: more, move, sort, export options.
anatomy: Trigger: an icon, or words with a chevron

options.name: trigger
options.description: An icon alone (with its label as tooltip) or words with a chevron.

rules: Use the platform's menu; never draw a custom popover for a list of actions.
accessibility: The trigger has the menu's label.
